_coder: claude-opus-5, single coder, inter-coder agreement UNMEASURED

competitions.name: IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection
competitions.evidence: time-aware validation (train 4 months, gap, predict later month); UID/client/card identity reconstruction; adversarial and time validation considered

competitions.name: Santander Customer Transaction Prediction
competitions.evidence: identifying synthetic/fake test rows; understanding of test generation changed the win condition

competitions.name: Home Credit Default Risk
competitions.evidence: multiple relational tables, time ordering, sequence representation

competitions.name: Elo Merchant Category Recommendation
competitions.evidence: CV design central; explicit shared judgement to trust CV over public LB; time information; ensemble

competitions.name: TalkingData AdTracking Fraud Detection
competitions.evidence: day-level holdout; time-aware target/count encoding

competitions.name: Avito Demand Prediction
competitions.evidence: heterogeneous text/image/tabular representations; 3rd combined a 5-fold ensemble with a time-series-validation ensemble

competitions.name: Mercari Price Suggestion
competitions.evidence: 1st concentrated on a single sparse-input MLP; named in the source as the counterexample to 'many families and complex ensembles are required'

competitions.name: American Express Default Prediction
competitions.evidence: customer time-series aggregation, autoregressive representation, OOF/time features; 16th made feature diversity/ensemble its explicit theme

competitions.name: Jane Street Market Prediction
competitions.evidence: time embedding, stock/entity structure, target denoising, online inference design

competitions.name: Rossmann Store Sales
competitions.evidence: winner states reliable holdout design was the single most important insight; temporal holdout extrapolating to the private period

competitions.name: Corporacion Favorita Grocery Sales
competitions.evidence: LightGBM, CNN/DNN, seq2seq — markedly different families; time-series representation itself the main search object

competitions.name: M5 Forecasting Accuracy
competitions.evidence: mixed families at the top; hierarchical aggregation/scaling of the M5 metric affects evaluation stability — understanding the validation metric itself was the problem

competitions.name: Web Traffic Time Series
competitions.evidence: seasonality, robust statistics, time-series-specific representation/ensemble

competitions.name: Recruit Restaurant Visitor Forecasting
competitions.evidence: calendar/holiday handling, temporal imputation, mapping holidays onto same weekday

competitions.name: ASHRAE Great Energy Predictor III
competitions.evidence: building/meter/weather/time structure; handling of leak and external information was a major research theme

competitions.name: TGS Salt Identification
competitions.evidence: beyond architecture: augmentation, resolution, mask/post-processing, loss combinations explored

competitions.name: Airbus Ship Detection
competitions.evidence: explicit 'trust CV over LB' lesson; search for overlap between train images; classification/detection/segmentation as different problem decompositions

competitions.name: Severstal Steel Defect Detection
competitions.evidence: classification+segmentation and class-wise decomposition; decomposing into independent subtasks for stability

competitions.name: RSNA Pneumonia Detection
competitions.evidence: problem representation itself differed among top solutions (RetinaNet, single-stage detector, U-Net segmentation)

competitions.name: SIIM-ACR Pneumothorax
competitions.evidence: multiple problem decompositions present at the top: classification+segmentation, semi-supervision, mask filtering/scoring

competitions.name: Humpback Whale Identification
competitions.evidence: solution families differ greatly (classification, ArcFace, SIFT+Siamese); representation/hypothesis diversity mattered before model diversity

competitions.name: Bengali.AI Handwritten Grapheme
competitions.evidence: 5th was seed diversity within one SEResNeXt family; named in the source as a counterexample to 'different model families are always required'

competitions.name: Planet Amazon
competitions.evidence: public/private shake-up observed; a case showing the risk of adapting to the LB alone

competitions.name: Carvana Image Masking
competitions.evidence: high-resolution segmentation, coarse-to-fine/refinement — problem decomposition mattered

competitions.name: DSTL Satellite Imagery
competitions.evidence: domain representation (multispectral bands, spectral indices, boundary treatment); 3rd competitive without a complex ensemble — counterexample to ensemble-diversity universalism

competitions.name: Quora Insincere Questions
competitions.evidence: matching local CV to LB under a short runtime was central; large public-to-private shake-up recorded

competitions.name: Jigsaw Toxic Comment Classification
competitions.evidence: 1st gained training signal from unlabeled test via pseudo-labeling

competitions.name: Jigsaw Unintended Bias
competitions.evidence: subgroup/BPSN/BNSP metric structure targeted directly; named as the clear case of metric decomposition and subgroup error understanding

competitions.name: Quora Question Pairs
competitions.evidence: duplicate/question relationship exploited; many features and multi-level models rather than a single text classifier

competitions.name: Tweet Sentiment Extraction
competitions.evidence: reverse-engineering the label generation rule; reranking and post-processing were the top differentiators

competitions.name: Google QUEST Q&A Labeling
competitions.evidence: multi-model beyond the BERT family; target/post-processing research; independent discovery of post-processing magic

competitions.name: CommonLit Readability Prize
competitions.evidence: external data, teacher/student, sentence representation — representation learning beyond the training distribution

competitions.name: Feedback Prize ELL
competitions.evidence: back-translation, rank loss, pseudo-labeling, pooling explored; 2nd recorded the CV/PB contribution of rank loss and back-translation

competitions.name: H&M Personalized Fashion Recommendations
competitions.evidence: the research structure was candidate generation to feature engineering to ranking to ensembling; candidate recall defined the solution space

competitions.name: Santander Product Recommendation
competitions.evidence: customer history and temporal product transitions structured beyond raw multiclass prediction

competitions.name: Riiid Answer Correctness Prediction
competitions.evidence: lag/time features and online-inference consistency; diverse families; 28th's Transformer contributed to the ensemble despite a low standalone CV

competitions.name: Google Landmark Retrieval
competitions.evidence: metric learning, clean-sample weighting, different training datasets, high-resolution fine-tuning, ensemble

competitions.name: NOMAD Materials
competitions.evidence: representations differ fundamentally (crystal graph, handcrafted descriptors+GBDT, SOAP+NN); comparing representation/model error correlation was the scientific search
